ModMetaData.name: RimMandrake: SW — Forsaken Crags Fauna
ModMetaData.author: mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
FORSAKEN_CRAGS_PREDATORS_BUILD_1 — Cindermare and Skarnix, two wild `AB_RockyCrags` threats promoted from owner-approved mockup art (`FORSAKEN_CRAGS_FAUNA_1`). Both untameable (wildness 1.0). Cindermare kills by a mouthless cold-drain grip (a real `RSW_ColdDrainDamage`/`RSW_ColdDrain` injury chain, not flavor text) rather than a bite. Skarnix avoids lit ground via `CompLightAversion`, a forced-Goto-to-darkness comp mirroring vanilla's own `HediffComp_Disorientation` force-job pattern.
LIVESTOCK_STARTER_TRIO_1 — karrask (molt-plate), tameable Jawa farm stock: a vanilla `CompProperties_Shearable` molt (zero new job types) plus a bench `RecipeDef` curing the raw shed into wearable plate. Onnik and moornak (the other two legs of the trio) are not yet built — see that item file. Art for karrask is still a placeholder texPath pending sprite generation.
RimStarWars tier (world/planet fauna, not campaign-specific) per `NAMING_SCHEME_PLAN.md`.
